summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose daily ASX notifications regarding its existing, previously authorized $1 billion share repurchase program. The filing updates the market on transactions executed under the program and repeats forward-looking statements about possible future repurchases. There are no new terms, no change in authorization, and no tender offer or issuer self-tender. This is a routine disclosure filing, not a special-situation event. The registrant is the issuer of the shares being repurchased. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural details are provided. The filing does not constitute a standalone capital-return event.
